title: Lua Scripting
subtitle: EVAL, EVALSHA, and atomic multi-command operations

content.text: Redis executes Lua scripts atomically. This lets you combine multiple commands without race conditions.
Scripts run atomically and block the server. Keep them short and fast.

questions.question: Why are Redis Lua scripts atomic?
options: Redis is single-threaded and runs the script without interruption
questions.explanation: Redis's single-threaded execution model means no other commands run while a Lua script is executing.

faq.a: EVALSHA runs a previously loaded script by its SHA1 hash, avoiding resending the script text on every call.
